title: Report backend shutdown scheduling failures truthfully
summary: Remediate AUDIT-FIND-W01-005 by returning a failed lifecycle command result when delayed backend-shutdown scheduling fails synchronously.
reason: The shutdown helper currently logs Timer construction or start failures but the route still acknowledges the shutdown as accepted, leaving the shell with false lifecycle ownership evidence while the backend continues serving.
affected_areas: Tauri and native close lifecycle ownership
generated source summaries and change-control evidence
behavior_before: POST /api/backend/shutdown returns ok=true even when the only Timer construction or start attempt failed before the response was built.
behavior_after: The route distinguishes a successfully scheduled delayed shutdown from a synchronous scheduling failure, returns and journals a bounded non-success result on failure, and leaves the backend available for a later retry.
tests_added: HTTP command-journal persistence for shutdown scheduling failure
Timer constructor and start fault injection with truthful mixin results
affected Tauri backend open and close smoke coverage
successful delayed callback timing and failed-request retry semantics
